DATE-TRAP WARNING FILE — not for citation. Air & Space Forces Magazine, "READ: Hegseth's Speech to Generals and Admirals", published 30 September 2025 (NOT 2026).

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: searching for the content of today's Hegseth "State of the Force" speech returns a large volume of full transcripts and colour reporting from the Quantico address of 30 SEPTEMBER 2025 — exactly one year ago to the day, at the same base. Every one of the following is 2025 copy and must NOT be used as today's:
- "Good morning, and welcome to the War Department, because the era of the Department of Defense is over."
- "fat generals and admirals ... a bad look" / "No more beardos" / "the era of unacceptable appearance is over"
- "If the words I'm speaking today are making your heart sink, then you should do the honorable thing and resign."
- the ten Department of War directives, the "highest male standard only" combat MOS directive, the IG/EO/MEO "no more walking on eggshells" overhaul
- Trump's follow-on speech about using "dangerous cities as training grounds" and "the enemy within"
Carriers of this 2025 material include airandspaceforces.com, stripes.com, defensescoop.com, airforcetimes.com, starrs.us and an ABC News piece (abcnews.com/Politics/pentagons-mystery-meeting-top-ranking-generals/story?id=126055917, dated 30 Sep 2025).

STATUS AS AT 19:10 BST, 30 SEPTEMBER 2026: I found NO approved-outlet report of what Hegseth actually SAID in the 2026 "State of the Force" address. Approved coverage (Al Jazeera, BBC) is all pre-delivery and prospective ("will cut", "expected to announce"). Write the story as the announced 20% billet cut, not as delivered-speech quotes.
